description: This file defines the ComponentData class, a simple Java data model used within the Fineract project to represent components, with fields such as id, key, text, description, and sequenceNo, including constructors and getter/setter methods.

classes.name: ComponentData
classes.description: A plain Java object (POJO) representing a component with identifiers, descriptive text, and sequence order.

methods.name: ComponentData
methods.description: Default constructor for creating an empty ComponentData object.

methods.name: ComponentData
methods.description: Parameterized constructor for creating a ComponentData object with specified properties.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the component.

methods.name: getKey
methods.description: Returns the key associated with the component.

methods.name: setKey
methods.description: Sets the key for the component.

methods.name: getText
methods.description: Returns the display text of the component.

methods.name: setText
methods.description: Sets the display text for the component.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Returns the description of the component.

methods.name: setDescription
methods.description: Sets the description of the component.

methods.name: getSequenceNo
methods.description: Returns the sequence number of the component.

methods.name: setSequenceNo
methods.description: Sets the sequence number for ordering components.
